name: gscdump
description: gscdump syncs Google Search Console data, backfills up to 16 months of available history, and preserves your collected data for MCP, API, and SQL.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT about your Google Search Console data. gscdump connects your Sites with one Google sign-in, backfills up to 16 months of available history, and keeps your record after Google deletes it.

Ask which pages lost clicks, which queries sit on page two, or whether a page is indexed. Answers come from your rows, with the dates they cover.

Evidence tools only read your data. inspect-url asks Google live and uses your URL Inspection allowance. connect-site adds a Site to your gscdump account and starts its backfill. submit-indexnow sends the URLs you choose to IndexNow. submit-feedback and record-agent-outcome send reports to gscdump. Nothing writes to Google.

Open source: the gscdump engine, CLI, and SDK are MIT licensed on GitHub.
capabilities: Read Site sync status and date ranges
Read stored queries, pages, and search metrics
Read Sitemaps and stored indexing evidence
Inspect a Site URL through Google
defaultPrompt: Which of my Sites lost the most clicks this week?
Which queries sit at positions 4 to 20 with high impressions?
Is my home page indexed by Google? Show the verdict and the date.

positive.description: List accessible Sites and their stored date ranges
positive.prompt: Using the gscdump sample connection, which of my Sites have synced data, and what date range does each one cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only Sites the reviewer can access, with sync status and date range. It does not claim every date contains stored rows. Labels all results as synthetic sample data.

positive.description: Read the top queries from one accessible Site
positive.prompt: Using the gscdump sample connection, choose one of my Sites with synced data. Show its top 5 queries for the most recent complete 7 days in its record.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the chosen Site and exact dates. Returns up to five stored queries with clicks, impressions, CTR, and position. Reports empty or unavailable data accurately. Labels all results as synthetic sample data.

positive.description: Compare page clicks across two stored periods
positive.prompt: Using the gscdump sample connection, choose one of my Sites with at least 14 days of stored data. Which pages lost the most clicks between its two most recent complete 7-day periods? Show a small table.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-pages for both periods. Shows the Site, exact dates, clicks in each period, and the change. It does not invent data for an uncovered period. Labels all results as synthetic sample data.

positive.description: Inspect an actual page on an accessible Site
positive.prompt: Using the gscdump sample connection, inspect one sample page. Show the simulated coverage state, canonical URL, and crawl time.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects a sample Page and calls inspect-url. Labels every returned field as a synthetic fixture. Makes no claim about live Google indexing.

positive.description: Read stored totals within confirmed coverage
positive.prompt: Using the gscdump sample connection, choose one of my synced Sites. Show total clicks and impressions for the most recent complete 7 days in its record. State the Site and exact dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns stored totals for the chosen Site and dates. Preserves any coverage or availability warning. It does not claim the totals cover every host in a broader Google property. Labels all results as synthetic sample data.

negative.description: MCP tools cannot submit Sitemaps. Refuse the write request; stored Sitemap status may be read.
negative.prompt: Using gscdump, submit a sitemap for one of my Sites to Google Search Console.

negative.description: A Site absent from the reviewer account is inaccessible. Refuse the request without invented metrics.
negative.prompt: Using gscdump, what are the top queries for github.com this month?

negative.description: An unrelated writing request should not call gscdump.
negative.prompt: Write a haiku about search engine optimization.
